occurrences.source_fact: The Service Provider shall fully cooperate with the Bank and its authorized representatives in investigating any Data Breach, including providing timely access to relevant information, records, and systems to assess its nature and impact. The Service Provider shall assist the Bank in identifying the cause(s) of the Data Breach, addressing vulnerabilities, and taking immediate corrective action to mitigate effects, prevent further unauthorized access or disclosure, and reduce recurrence risk.
